nodes.name: PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Master plan for the Waggle OS addictiveness and 10-persona audit, outlining the execution order, constraints (workflow-reality-check rule), and the set of files produced by the audit.

nodes.name: RUBRIC.md
nodes.summary: Defines the 10-dimension addictiveness scoring rubric (Eyal Hook Model + Fogg Behavior Model) used across all persona evaluations, including honesty rules and scoring criteria for triggers, actions, variable rewards, and investment dimensions.

nodes.name: PERSONAS.md
nodes.summary: Defines 10 user personas spanning the full tech-knowledge spectrum (P1 Greta through P10 Tomás) used to evaluate Waggle OS addictiveness, with spectrum coverage matrix and workflow-reality-check pre-validation.

nodes.name: SURFACES.md
nodes.summary: Inventory of all 25 Waggle OS UI surfaces (dock apps, screens, overlays) mapped to the 10 addictiveness rubric dimensions, providing the codebase-grounded foundation for persona scoring.

nodes.name: BASELINE.md
nodes.summary: Baseline addictiveness audit scoring matrix for 10 personas across 10 rubric dimensions, with cell-by-cell evidence, score distribution, and a Pareto of fixes tiered by impact (Tier 1 surgical/shippable, Tier 2 mid-size, Tier 3 strategic).

nodes.name: BENCHMARK-claude-code-nc.md
nodes.summary: Competitive analysis of Claude Code for non-coders, documenting its product surface, sticky design patterns, hook moments, weaknesses Waggle can exploit, and strengths Waggle must match.

nodes.name: BENCHMARK-cowork.md
nodes.summary: Competitive analysis of Claude Cowork (Anthropic), covering daily-driver features, addictive design patterns, onboarding hook moments, pricing, and strategic gaps Waggle can exploit.

nodes.name: BENCHMARK-hermes.md
nodes.summary: Competitive analysis of Hermes Agent (Nous Research), including reality-check on capabilities, lock-in features, sticky design, onboarding, OSS vs hosted pricing, and strategic opportunities for Waggle.

nodes.name: BENCHMARK-openclaw.md
nodes.summary: Competitive analysis of OpenClaw documenting its lock-in features, stickiness design, UI surface, onboarding hook, pricing, and the top weaknesses Waggle can exploit plus strengths to match.

nodes.name: FEATURE-REQUESTS.md
nodes.summary: Prioritized feature request backlog (FR-1 through FR-10) derived from the 10-persona addictiveness audit, spanning browser companion, Telegram digests, marketplace hosting, memory trophy, demo workspaces, and Excel integration, with strategic bets and anti-patterns rejected.

nodes.name: ITER-1-RESULTS.md
nodes.summary: Results of the first addictiveness audit iteration (2026-05-28), documenting shipped changes, modest score movement with honest rationale, and candidate items for the next surgical iteration.

nodes.name: ITER-2-RESULTS.md
nodes.summary: Results of iteration 2 (Tier-2 work begins), covering FR-1 browser companion companion implementation, score movement across all personas, and remaining pending items requiring manual verification.

nodes.name: ITER-3-RESULTS.md
nodes.summary: Results of iteration 3 documenting FR-2 Telegram outbound digest server-side plumbing, with honest scope disclosure (zero score movement this iteration), next candidates, and manual verification path.

nodes.name: ITER-4-RESULTS.md
nodes.summary: Results of iteration 4 documenting the FR-2 Telegram Settings UI tile implementation, deferred ScheduledJobs output-channel integration, honest score assessment (5.9/10), and iter-5 candidates.

nodes.name: ITER-5-RESULTS.md
nodes.summary: Results of iteration 5 closing the FR-2 cron-to-Telegram loop (server runtime + UI part 2 + end-to-end verification), with honest score movement per persona and remaining 3.6-point gap analysis.

nodes.name: ITER-6-RESULTS.md
nodes.summary: Results of iteration 6 (FR-5 sample workspace import), the biggest single-iteration score jump, documenting backend and UI implementation with live smoke-test verification, cumulative score trajectory, and remaining 2.9-point gap.

nodes.name: ITER-7-RESULTS.md
nodes.summary: Results of iteration 7 (polish chunk: consultant and engineer workspace bundles + F4 coverage compass card), with first personas reaching 10/10, cumulative score trajectory, remaining 2.3-point gap, and realistic next-turn targets.

nodes.name: REDUNDANCY-AUDIT.md
nodes.summary: Post-loop redundancy audit of the addictiveness iteration series (iters 1-8), identifying two redundant parallel systems built during FR-3 and FR-5, root cause analysis, verification blind spots, and re-scored net result.
